text: I am writing to respectfully request the implementation of speed humps on Rushton Road, between Humewood Gardens and Wellwood Avenue. An overwhelming number of residents are requesting this traffic calming option to address speeding concerns and other forms of reckless driver behavior that endanger kids. My office has worked closely with Traffic Operations staff in coming up with the recommendations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorize the installation of traffic calming (speed hump) on Rushton Road, between Humewood Gardens and Wellwood Avenue. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter a section of the roadway on Rushton Road, between Humewood Gardens and Wellwood Avenue, to install one speed hump, generally as shown on the copy of 'Drawing No. 421G-4006’ dated April, 2022 from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
